title: VerifierBench: Benchmarking the Generation of Executable Verifiers for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.28679v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents need reliable ways to validate their outputs, both when completing tasks and when filtering synthetic training data. We study verifier generation: from the instruction and environment available for solving a task, an agent writes an executable verifier that must accept every valid solution and reject invalid ones. We introduce VerifierBench, a benchmark of 222 tasks from six agent benchmarks spanning tool-call, state-based, and code verification, with 4,993 hidden test cases that include alternative valid solutions and attacks; Verifier4Verifier (V4V), a six-check audit, screens its source verifiers and test suites. Across 19 models in a common agent harness, normalized balanced accuracy ranges from 10.6 to 62.1, with generated verifiers consistently rejecting invalid solutions more reliably than they accept valid ones. translated_title: VerifierBench：面向大语言模型智能体的可执行验证器生成基准测试
translated_abstract: 智能体需要可靠的方法来验证其输出，无论是在完成任务时，还是在过滤合成训练数据时。我们研究验证器生成问题：根据求解任务可用的指令和环境，智能体编写一个可执行的验证器，该验证器必须接受所有有效解并拒绝无效解。我们提出了VerifierBench，这是一个包含来自六个智能体基准的222个任务的基准测试，涵盖工具调用、基于状态和代码三类验证，配有4,993个隐藏测试用例，其中包括替代有效解和攻击样例；并通过六项检查的审计机制Verifier4Verifier（V4V）对其源验证器和测试套件进行筛查。在统一的智能体框架下对19个模型进行评估，归一化平衡准确率介于10.6至62.1之间，生成的验证器在拒绝无效解方面始终比接受有效解更为可靠。这种表面上的优势可能掩盖了过度严格的验证问题：在所分析的记录中，大多数错误拒绝…
tldr: 该论文提出了VerifierBench基准，用于评估大语言模型智能体生成可执行验证器的能力，发现现有模型生成的验证器虽然能可靠地拒绝无效解，但往往因过于严格而错误拒绝有效解。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VerifierBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents' ability to generate executable verifiers, finding that generated verifiers consistently reject invalid solutions more reliably than they accept valid ones, which can mask overly restrictive verification.
